question: Who in Team TS3012 wanted a scroll-wheel, what was the argument against it, and was it in the design?
answer: Speaker C (Industrial Designer) wanted the scroll-wheel as a flashy design feature; others argued it had no useful added function, took up space, and scrolling through channels could be annoying. It was ultimately left out: the team said, “No r no scroll-wheel. Okay.”
